title: How is the Luhn Algorithm Check Digit Calculated?

cues.en: In the previous lecture, I mentioned that our bank account number is going to have a three digit bank code, a three digit branch code, two digits of currency code.
cues.zh: 上一堂提到，銀行帳號包含 3 位銀行代碼、3 位分行代碼，以及 2 位貨幣代碼。

cues.en: Then you're going to have seven random digits.
Then you're going to have one digit, which is going to be the check digit, which is going to be used for security.
cues.zh: 最後 1 位是檢查碼，講者說用於安全驗證。

cues.en: To create this check digit, we're going to be using something called the Luhn algorithm.
cues.zh: 產生這個檢查碼時，會使用 Luhn 演算法。

cues.en: So before we can create our check digit, let me walk you through an example of how to calculate this check digit so that when we get to implementing it in our code within this utils.py file, it's going
cues.zh: 在建立檢查碼前，先透過範例說明如何計算，這樣在 utils.py 實作時。

cues.en: to be a bit easy to understand.
So the code I'm about to type, please don't type it out.
cues.zh: 接下來輸入的程式碼，你不必跟著打。

cues.en: You can just ignore it because I'm going to delete all of it.
cues.zh: 可以先忽略，因為稍後會全部刪掉。

cues.en: Then we can actually work on the function.
This is just an example.
So let's say we have a number and that number is 799.
cues.zh: 假設有一個數字，開頭是 799。

cues.en: Then 273 then 9871.
So what you're going to do using the Luhn algorithm to generate the check digit, we're first going to convert this number into digits.
cues.zh: 使用 Luhn 演算法產生檢查碼時，先把這個數字拆成個別位數。

cues.en: So you can say digits.
That's going to be Comma nine, comma nine, then two, seven, then three, nine, eight, seven, one like that.
Then we're going to separate the odd and the even positioned digits, not even or odd digits, but the even positioned digits as you can see, odd digits.
cues.zh: 接著分開奇數與偶數位置的位數；這裡是位置的奇偶，而非數字本身的奇偶，先看 odd_digits。

cues.en: So if you look at the odd positioned digits is going to be we're starting from right towards left.
cues.zh: 奇數位置的數字從右往左數。

cues.en: That's going to be one, then eight, then three, then two, then nine.
Remember, these are not odd digits but the odd positioned digits.
cues.zh: 記得不是奇數值，而是奇數位置的數字。

cues.en: So we have one, eight, three, two and then nine.
Then we're going to do the same for the even positioned digits.
That's going to be seven nine then seven, nine, then seven.
Then you're going to sum up the odd positioned digits by saying total.
cues.zh: 接著將奇數位置的數字加總，設定 total。

cues.en: That's going to be one plus eight, then plus three, then plus two plus nine.
That's going to be 23.
Then we're going to process the even positioned digits by first doubling the numbers.
cues.zh: 接著處理偶數位置的數字，先將每個數字乘以 2。

cues.en: So if you look at the even positioned digits we're going to start with seven.
cues.zh: 看偶數位置，先從 7 開始。

cues.en: So we're going to say seven multiplied by two.
That's going to be 14.
Then we're going to call this function that we created up above called split into digits.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫剛建立的 split_into_digits。

cues.en: So you can see here split into digits.
If you pass in 14 that's going to be an array of one and four like that.
cues.zh: 傳入 14，得到包含 1 與 4 的陣列。

cues.en: Then we're going to sum this.
So the sum is going to be one plus four which is equal to five.
And so we're going to do the same thing for nine and seven nine and seven.
So let me just duplicate that a couple of times.
Then we're going to have nine times two which is going to be 18.
You split it into digits.
We're splitting 18.
That's going to be one and eight.
And the sum is going to be nine.
Then you're going to do the same for seven which is going to be five.
Then we do it for nine again.
So let me copy nine paste it right there.
cues.zh: 複製 9 的內容，貼在這裡。

cues.en: Then we do seven.
So you're going to have 5959 and five like that.
So now what we're going to do is we're going to get the total of these numbers.
cues.zh: 接著計算這些數字的總和。

cues.en: That is as a result of processing the event positioned digits.
cues.zh: 也就是處理偶數位置後得到的結果。

cues.en: So you're going to have a five plus nine plus a five plus nine plus five.
That's going to be 33.
Actually, it's five plus nine then.
Plus five plus nine plus five.
So we have three fives and two nines.
Yeah.
If you check here we have five, five, five then nine and nine.
So you get the total being 23.
Then we're going to calculate the final total.
The final total is going to be this sum 33 which is as a result of processing the even digits then the total of the odd positioned digits.
cues.zh: 最後總和是處理偶數位置得到的 33，再加上奇數位置數字的總和。

cues.en: So that's going to be 33 plus this 23 up here which is going to be a 56.
cues.zh: 也就是 33 加上前面的 23，等於 56。

cues.en: Then we can now calculate the check digit.
And we're going to do that by saying total then modulo ten to get the remainder.
cues.zh: 先對 total 做 modulo 10，取得餘數。

cues.en: So in our case that's going to be 56 modulo ten which is going to be six.
Then we're going to say ten subtract total modulus ten.
cues.zh: 接著計算 10 減去 total % 10。

cues.en: So in our case that's going to be ten minus six which is going to be four.
Then.
Then again say ten again minus total modulo ten.
cues.zh: 再寫一次 10 減去 total % 10。

cues.en: then the result of that modulo ten, which in our case is going to be four modulo ten, which is going to be four.
cues.zh: 再將結果對 10 取餘數，本例為 4 % 10，等於 4。

cues.en: So this basically means that the check digit for this number that you had started with, which is this the check digit is going to be before like that.
cues.zh: 這表示最初這個數字的檢查碼是 4。

cues.en: So this is more or less the logic we're going to be using to create our check digit number.
cues.zh: 這大致就是產生檢查碼的邏輯。

cues.en: So I hope this makes sense.
So what you can do is let's just get rid of all of this.
This is just an example.
And if you want to read more you can always just Google for the Luhn algorithm, look at the examples or just Google the learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 想進一步閱讀，可以搜尋 Luhn 演算法與範例。

cues.en: Then you can read more about it.
It's basically used to create credit card numbers and other secure numbers.
cues.zh: 它基本上用於產生信用卡號及其他安全號碼。

cues.en: And in our case, we're going to be using it to generate the check digit for the bank account, because that is more or less a standard practice in banking.
cues.zh: 本例會用它產生銀行帳號的檢查碼；講者說這大致是銀行業的標準做法。

cues.en: So you're going to go back to our code then that is it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 回到程式碼，這堂課就到這裡。

cues.zh: 下一堂實際撰寫計算檢查碼的函式，現在已大致理解理論運作方式。
